rows.title: Out of Sight movie review & film summary
rows.dek_lead: For Steven Soderbergh, “Out of Sight” is a paradox. It’s his best film since “sex, lies, and videotape” a decade ago, and yet at the same time it’s not what we think of as a Soderbergh film–detached, cold,analytical.
